sources.title: StochasticSplats: Stochastic Rasterization for Sorting-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
sources.finding: Section 3.4 explicitly samples free-flight distances for overlapping Gaussians independently and selects the minimum. The supplement derives Gaussian CDF/inverse-CDF sampling. Thus this sampling operation is already described; no code or timing was reproduced.
sources.limits: This fixed version does not establish current implementation behavior or rule out every possible control-variate refinement.

sources.title: Primary-Space Adaptive Control Variates using Piecewise-Polynomial Approximations
sources.finding: Known surrogate expectation plus sampled residual is the standard control-variate form. Its covariance coefficient governs variance reduction; unit coefficient is not universally optimal.
sources.limits: The paper's polynomial construction is not claimed to implement this particular coupled Gaussian surrogate.

sources.title: Imperfect Image-Space Control Variates for Monte Carlo Rendering
sources.version: Author project page, ACM TOG / SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 as displayed; accessed 30 October 2026
sources.finding: The authors distinguish classical control variates with known expectations from their noisy estimated image-space expectations. T39 has a known surrogate expectation and does not solve that latter problem.
sources.limits: No full paper, supplementary material or code opened.

scope: Targeted disqualification only; not a systematic novelty survey. No timing or experimental result inferred from these pages. Mathematical derivations in README are our analysis.
